dct_description_sm: At upper right: Office, Commissioner of Public Buildings, D.C.

At upper right: Office, Commissioner of Public Buildings, D.C. Facsim. of ms. L'Enfant plan. Includes texts containing letters dated "Washington ... 1887," notes, descriptive index of "References," and U.S.C. & G.S. insigne. Lacks text below "N.I." At lower right: N.I. In right upper margin: No. 3035a price 50 cents. LC copies fold-lined and mounted on cloth backing. Copy 2 also laminated and trimmed. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Original version: [1791]. 2 copies DCP
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
